newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa may face new test of support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa may face new test of support.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa could be in danger of retesting support at 980 stg, technical analysts said.
The speed of its recent upmove has not been as fast as its downmove, Susan Rigg, a technical analyst at Chart Analysis, said.
"There's a danger of it coming back and testing 980," she said.
Traders called it to open four stg lower.
Benchmark July had shown tremendous selling pressure at 1,060 stg, she said. "It needs a fast upward move to negate the downward pressure, she said.
If 980 stg were broken, Rigg saw resistance at 960 stg and then 940.

Brokers GNI too saw a possible test of 980 stg. "If a quick recovery is not seen today, then a test of 980 stg would be seen very quickly," GNI said. "This could cause the abandonment of some very large fund positions."
New York cocoa ended broadly lower in light volume Tuesday after a late-day round of speculative liquidation, dealers said.

Next week Brazil's port of Ilheus will receive the first of an anticipated 15,000 tonnes of cocoa to be imported up to August because a shortfall in the midcrop, said an official at one of the importing companies.
Declared arrivals of Ivory Coast's 1996/97 (October-September) cocoa crop totalled 1.015 million tonnes by May 4, industry sources said.
The figure, which includes the 1996/97 main crop (October-April) plus the first four days of the smaller mid-crop (May-September), was just under 1.045 million by April 30 last year.
